before_after.ratio_definition: after / before; below one means shorter time or lower output cost
before_after.timing_caveat: Sessions remain separate. Unchanged Qiskit, Cirq and TKET recipes are drift controls. Before/after timing alone does not establish causal attribution or remove host drift.
before_after.quality_caveat: CX count and depth are circuit-cost proxies, not execution fidelity or optimality. This corpus informed the fixes and is not an untouched generalization holdout.

study_metadata.machine_note: Same Apple M3 host and Python environment as preserved routing study; sequential persistent workers and identical single-thread runtime settings. No concurrent builds, tests, simulations, analysis or benchmark sessions during either timing session. Ordinary OS activity uncontrolled; no CPU affinity or frequency locking. Both timing sessions finish before validation. Bounded routing candidate retention; previous studies preserved.

recipes.cirq_one_pass: same Cirq structure, max one synthesis iteration per phase

study_metadata.timing_boundary: Warm in-process compile_ns: cloning, configuration, passes and compiled-circuit retrieval. Parsing is parse_ns. Imports/startup, serialization, IPC and checking are outside compile_ns. request_wall_ns covers the complete worker request/response. noncompile_nonparse_request_ns is wall minus parse minus compile: it combines serialization, layouts, diagnostics, IPC and interpreter overhead, and is NOT isolated serialization time.

presentation_note: Compact presentation of preserved analyses. Individual family ratios, complete-case quality records and individual failed-trial records are omitted; worst-tail lists retain three entries and changed-trial lists retain ten. Counts and aggregate statistics remain. The evidence archive retains complete records. This view also omits duplicated fixed-cohort summaries, full case-change cells and unchanged-SDK timing-tail lists. Public CSV copies use LF line endings. Primary/light views reuse the same Q-Rust and Qiskit observations. Two sessions are timing repetitions, not additional independent circuits. The figure uses the follow-up primary all-four common cohort in both sessions; any profile-specific missing pairs remain explicit in the comparison statistics. Original results are separate artifacts.
